BETA
Local stdio resource discovery and manifest tools are the supported core boundary. Remote HTTP/SSE, recommendations and advanced mutation workflows are Beta; this public Site does not host an MCP process.
← Back to Documentation
Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Enable AI coding agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Antigravity) to query and integrate Tessellate components autonomously.

Configuration

Add the Tessellate MCP server to your AI agent configuration:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "tessellate": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@tessellate/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
Available MCP Tools
search_resources: Searches the 324-resource catalogue by keyword, category, or role.
get_resource: Retrieves the complete validated ResourceManifest for a given component slug.
get_resource_code: Fetches the raw TypeScript React source code for immediate insertion.
recommend_resources BETA: Scores and recommends resources for a page goal; semantic quality has not yet been manually adjudicated.
find_alternatives BETA: Suggests alternatives; candidate relevance and compatibility need further evaluation.
